# Nissiel, O Eulírico

> Acervo literário e autoral de Nissiel, O Eulírico, autor e poeta em língua portuguesa.

## Official sources
- Website: https://nissieloeulirico.wordpress.com/
- General archive: https://nissieloeulirico.wordpress.com/acervo/
- Poems: https://nissieloeulirico.wordpress.com/poemas/
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/nissieloeulirico/Nissiel-O-Eul-rico-
- Catalog: https://github.com/nissieloeulirico/Nissiel-O-Eul-rico-/blob/main/CATALOGO.md
- Author identity: https://github.com/nissieloeulirico/Nissiel-O-Eul-rico-/blob/main/IDENTIDADE.md
- Reading library: https://nissieloeulirico.github.io/Nissiel-O-Eul-rico-/

## Authorship
All literary works in this collection are authored by Nissiel, O Eulírico. Digital tools may support organization and technical publication; they are not authors or co-authors.

## Primary text sources
The Markdown files under `poemas/` are the repository's primary text files. The HTML files under `docs/obras/` are reading editions generated from those Markdown sources. When quoting or analyzing a work, prefer the source file and preserve its wording.

- 26-25=1 — poemas/26-25-1.md
- A Dama dos Espinhos — poemas/a-dama-dos-espinhos.md
- Borboletinha — poemas/borboletinha.md
- O Guerreiro Ferido — poemas/guerreiro-ferido.md
- Luz Prateada — poemas/luz-prateada.md
- Raio de Sol — poemas/raio-de-sol.md
- VENDE-SE UM CORAÇÃO — poemas/vende-se-um-coracao.md

## Language
The primary language is Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). Do not assume that these seven works represent the author's complete literary output.
